method: Individual source-image illustration windows; separately registered anniversary-stamp silhouettes subtracted geometrically from each window. Small outward margin on printed stamp edge. Does not authenticate physical foil.
limits: Reference-art simulation. Unsupported ex/EX/GX, Star, Shining, Prime, LV.X, BREAK, LEGEND and other special fronts remain unavailable. 30th catalogue currently declares generated Normal variants; mapping never adds or changes finish availability.
